title: Whitehead Problem
exact_target: If every abelian-group extension of a group by the integers splits, must that group have a basis over the integers? The unrestricted question is known to be independent of ZFC.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 42 (SET-003). CC BY 4.0.
Jeffrey Bergfalk, Chris Lambie-Hanson and Jan Šaroch, Whitehead’s Problem and Condensed Mathematics, arXiv:2312.09122v5 (2025), Section 1, original ordinary-group question and Theorem 1.1.
